punchline: Gibson says a child who always puts the parent's needs first leaves their own self where nobody can see it.
thirty_sec: Lindsay Gibson describes children of emotionally immature parents who take on a role: they put the parent's needs ahead of their own and deny theirs. Life looks normal from outside, since the basics are covered, but the loneliness deepens. Her first step toward healing is to reconnect with your authentic self and true feelings, then go into each conversation with a clear goal.
